content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a potential `NullPointerException` in the `FastDiag` constructor when the `progressCalback` object was null. The code did not properly check for null before calling methods on `progressCalback`, which could lead to runtime exceptions if it was not instantiated. The patch fixes this issue by adding null checks to ensure that methods are only called on `progressCalback` when it is not null, thereby preventing any `NullPointerExceptions`.
